description: Gene Ontology terms in the molecular_function namespace. Only non-obsolete terms with a final annotated-gene set of 2–1000 human genes, inclusive, are included. Gene associations include direct NCBI gene2go annotations and annotations propagated through GO is_a and part_of relationships; NOT annotations exclude genes from the affected term.

common_properties.name: identifier
common_properties.description: Gene Ontology identifier for the term.

common_properties.name: definition
common_properties.description: Formal definition of the GO term.

common_properties.name: synonyms
common_properties.description: Alternative names, including EXACT, RELATED, BROAD, and NARROW synonyms.

common_properties.name: xrefs
common_properties.description: Cross-references to external databases, such as EC, Reactome, and MetaCyc.

common_properties.name: aliases
common_properties.description: Alternative GO identifiers for the same term.

common_properties.name: license
common_properties.description: License for the ontology structure and term definitions: CC BY 4.0.

common_properties.name: url
common_properties.description: Canonical, stable OBO URL for the GO term.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data source for the term: Gene Ontology.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Date and time the node was last created or updated.

source_contributions.scope: Non-obsolete molecular_function terms meeting the 2–1000 annotated-human-gene inclusion threshold.
source_contributions.description: Provides term identifiers, labels, definitions, synonyms, cross-references, and alternative identifiers. GO hierarchy relationships inform gene associations but are not exposed as ontology hierarchy edges in SPOKE.
